articles.summary: Planning ahead and accounting for more than gifts can help consumers stay on budget throughout the holiday season St. Louis, MO (November 10, 2026) Financial experts say a little extra planning this holiday season can help families account for everyday costs while keeping gifts, travel, and celebrations enjoyable. According to First Mid Bank Trust Chief Retail Banking Officer Stas Wolak, holiday costs extend well beyond presents. A full grocery cart for a family meal, a few tanks of gas, higher utility use, plane tickets, restaurant tabs, decorations, shipping charges, and wrapping supplies can often rival the gift budget. Before the first gift is purchased, inflation has already taken a seat at the holiday table. The biggest financial surprise during the holidays is often not what people buy for others its all the additional expenses that come with celebrating, Wolak said. articles.summary: Des Moines, IA (November 16, 2026) First Mid Bank Trust (First Mid) announces that Stephanie Avery has joined the organization as VP, Regional Retail Loan Manager, serving the Greater Des Moines area. In her role, Avery will provide mortgage financing solutions to customers while leading First Mids mortgage lending efforts in the market. Bringing more than 25 years of mortgage lending experience to First Mid, Avery began her career in 1998 and moved into leadership roles in 2014. Her extensive knowledge allows her to guide borrowers through complex transactions, including home purchases and refinancing, while helping them achieve their homeownership goals. Im excited to join First Mid and bring my experience to a company that values relationships and the communities it serves, said Avery.
